_comment: Hand-authored half of the catalogue: category, layer, purpose, id_prefix. sockets/fixed/baseline are written by `brain_builder --gen-palette --merge` and reviewed like code. kinds overrides a required param's widget kind; sockets_extra adds pins probing cannot find.

ActionDecoder.purpose: Final action policy: consensus + drives → ActionOut (action.out)

ActionGate.purpose: Gates an action stream by a reflex or priority signal

AdaptiveThresholdTracker.purpose: Running-variance adaptive threshold for a scalar; publishes AdaptiveThreshold

BearingEstimator.purpose: Estimates the bearing to a source from egocentric cues

BearingFusion.purpose: Fuses several bearing estimates by their precision

BodyRhythmTracker.purpose: Tracks the body's dominant rhythm and phase from proprioception

CPGOscillator.purpose: Central pattern generator: a phase source for gait-level modules

CellReflex.purpose: Cell: the bundled reflex set (aversion, steer, escape)

ChemotaxisAI.purpose: Cell: chemotaxis as active inference on the scent channel

ChunkAbortGate.purpose: Aborts a playing chunk when surprise spikes

ChunkOutcomeGate.purpose: Grades a finished chunk's outcome against its expected drive reduction

ColumnBuilder.purpose: Stacks EPM tokens into a cortical-column style consensus input

CylinderBuilder.purpose: Builds a cylinder map from bearing estimates accumulated over time

DescendingPredictor.purpose: Top-down predictor of a reality topic from consensus; its prediction is subtracted in the target EPM

DistressDrive.purpose: Drive raised by distress events (falls, collisions) and relieved by recovery

DualEMADetector.purpose: Fast/slow exponential-moving-average change detector on a scalar stream

EFEArbiter.purpose: Arbitrates candidate behaviours by expected free energy

EPM.purpose: Episodic Predictive Module: frozen encoder + growing neural gas + dual TLE; publishes one RealityToken per tick on reality.<group>.<name>

EmbeddingRegistry.purpose: Registry of latent embeddings keyed by winner id, for lookups by other modules

EpisodicCapture.purpose: Captures episodes into chunk proposals for the repertoire

EventConjunction.purpose: Fires a derived event when named events coincide within a window

FaderController.purpose: Sets the fader alpha from a surprise signal

ForwardDriveReflex.purpose: Constant forward drive with reflex override

GNGRollout.purpose: Imagined-trajectory cache: rolls the GNG forward for candidate actions (RolloutQuery/RolloutResult)

GainEvolver.purpose: Evolves module gains from intrinsic fitness: candidate vs incumbent windows (GainVector)

GaitSelector.purpose: Selects among gaits by drive state

GoalBelief.purpose: Belief over goal bearing, updated by evidence and decayed by time

GradientEPM.purpose: EPM over the temporal gradient of a sensor stream rather than its level

HeadingController.purpose: PD on dead-reckoned own-yaw toward a heading reference, through the skid-steer channel

HeadingPlanner.purpose: Chooses a heading from beliefs and drives

HeadingProbe.purpose: Probes headings to gather bearing evidence for the goal belief

HomeokineticExploration.deprecated_note: superseded by intrinsic probes; kept for old configs

HomeostaticDrive.purpose: Homeostatic setpoints over events and sensors → drive errors and urgency on drive.errors

JointSensorimotorBridge.purpose: Per-joint [pos, action, delta] triples plus load slots between the body's joints and a MotorEPM; reads the action back

KeyframeAverager.purpose: Signal prep: downsamples a stream into keyframes (window average) before an EPM

KeyframePeakDetector.purpose: Detects peaks in a keyframed stream and emits events at them

Klinotaxis.purpose: Klinotaxis: turn by temporal comparison of scent samples

LateralVoter.purpose: Precision-weighted (1/(tle+eps)) fusion of many EPMs into one ConsensusToken on consensus.<level>

MotivationGate.purpose: Gates downstream behaviours by drive urgency

MotorBus.purpose: Arbitrates action channels by authority; publishes the per-side outputs the body reads

MotorEPM.purpose: Motor EPM v1: sensorimotor GNG with action readout

MotorEPMv2.purpose: Motor EPM v2: sensorimotor GNG with state prior, consolidation ratchet and homeokinetic controller; publishes action.* per joint

MotorFader.purpose: Crossfades brain and reflex action by surprise (FaderState)

MotorPlanner.purpose: Plans motor chunks against imagined rollouts and drive reduction

MotorRepertoire.purpose: Crystallised motor chunks with their outcome statistics (MotorChunks)

NeurochemState.purpose: Ambient dopamine/serotonin state from drive errors; scales GNG thresholds and exploration via neuro.state

PlaceGraphPlanner.purpose: Plans routes over a learned place graph

PlayLoop.purpose: Replays motor chunks and grades their outcome against the promise

PolicyChannelAggregator.purpose: Aggregates several policy channels into one action

PosturalPrior.purpose: Posture prior over joints from body pose

Premotor.purpose: Intent distribution over a consensus level → PolicyToken

PremotorAI.purpose: Active-inference premotor: intents scored by expected free energy

RunTumbleNav.purpose: Run-and-tumble navigation on a sensed gradient

RunTumbleNavV2.purpose: Run-and-tumble v2: adaptive run length from gradient confidence

ScentCompass.purpose: Turns the scent gradient into a compass-like bearing estimate

ScentGateReflex.purpose: Gates forward drive by the scent gradient

ScentHomingLearner.purpose: Learns a scent→heading mapping from homing outcomes

SensorBundle.purpose: Concatenates several proprio sensors into one ProprioToken for a downstream EPM

SequenceGNG.purpose: Temporal motif extractor over winner sequences; publishes SequenceMotif

StaleConfidenceDecay.purpose: Decays stale confidence in nodes that stop being visited

StuckEscapeReflex.purpose: Escape manoeuvre when motion stalls against an obstacle

SynergyTimer.purpose: Rhythm-phase logit bias per premotor on rhythm.bias.<premotor>

VisualBearing.purpose: Bearing to a target from the visual channel

VisualHomingNav.purpose: Visual homing toward a remembered view

WhiskerAversionReflex.purpose: Cell: veer away from whisker contact
